selection: systematic pilot, every 50th catalogue book_id plus frozen 40 seeds

v1.source: Mongo books: projected public metadata only
v1.normalization: NFKC, case-fold, whitespace; split only pipe delimiters. Names are metadata strings, not resolved human identities.
v1.scoring: Weighted cosine over shared typed features. weight=(2 for author else 1)*(1+ln((N+1)/(degree+1))). No embeddings, LLM, behavioral or availability score.
v1.scope: systematic pilot, every 50th catalogue book_id plus frozen 40 seeds

v2.source: Mongo books: projected public metadata only
v2.normalization: NFKC, case-fold, whitespace; split only pipe delimiters. Names are metadata strings, not resolved human identities.
v2.scoring: Weighted cosine using explicit relation weights and retained graph degree. Topic amplitude 0.5 gives one quarter of subject squared weight at equal degree; conservative untuned initial policy.
v2.scope: systematic pilot, every 50th catalogue book_id plus frozen 40 seeds

topic_policy.language_policy: Unicode source phrases; English stop words plus conservative generic terms. Language unknown, never inferred.

v2.weak_feature_qualification: Only author, subject and bounded description-topic connections qualify. Publisher/language/era unavailable and never qualify alone.
